description: Main window capability set. Audited 2026-05-11 (Phase 10): frontend uses invoke (@tauri-apps/api/core) and listen (@tauri-apps/api/event); plugin permissions cover dialog (file picker), opener (reveal-in-folder), autostart (start-with-Windows toggle). core:default is retained because narrowing it risks breaking invoke for built-in Tauri commands; the only built-in surface the frontend actually touches is event-listen, which is covered. All custom commands flow through the invoke_handler in lib.rs and are not gated by this list.
